Maya · Gujarati voice — listen & decide

Every clip is real Gujarati at 8 kHz (Exotel's format). Play them; the numbers are measured time-to-first-audio.

The decision — same voice vs speed

Left is Maya's exact ElevenLabs voice (Gargi) speaking Gujarati via eleven_v3 — one identity across all three languages, but slow. Right is Sarvam — a different but warm female voice, as responsive as her Hindi.
